t: This is the tomb of Karl Marx, in the Eastern cemetery of Highgate. Marx is buried here with his wife Jenny von Westphalen and other members of the family, including their daughter Eleanor, who translated her father's writings. The family was originally buried elsewhere in this cemetery and was moved here in 1954. The monument was designed by the sculptor Laurence Bradshaw, a lifelong socialist, and unveiled in 1956 at a ceremony led by Harry Pollitt of the Communist Party of Great Britain, which paid for it.
